title: A user with any role, including Viewer or a service account with no permissions, can create, externally publish, and…
description: A vulnerability in Grafana OSS and Grafana Enterprise version 12.4 allows any user, regardless of role or permissions, including Viewers and service accounts with no permissions, to create, externally publish, and delete dashboard snapshots due to missing authorization checks. Earlier versions and Grafana 13 are not affected.
